narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors totaled $2.5B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 7 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $355M. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.5B for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $11.9M for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $2.5B of FY2026 obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $11.9M of FY2026 obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors. Historical obligations include $78.4M in FY21. The page notes that award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date. The summary reflects obligations to date and the current award count and sizes for the vendor in FY2026.

sections.heading: Who are the biggest federal buyers this year?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer, with $2.5B in FY2026 obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors. The Department of Defense is a secondary buyer, with $11.9M in FY2026 obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes dominate the portfolio?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the dominant market, with $2.5B in FY2026 obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is a smaller market, with $11.9M in FY2026 obligations. The current award count is 7 and the average award size is $355M.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.5B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors has 7 awards so far in the fiscal year and an average award size of $355M. Historical obligations include $78.4M in FY21.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys the most from Southwest Valley Constructors, with $2.5B in FY2026 obligations. The Department of Defense also buys from Southwest Valley Constructors, with $11.9M in FY2026 obligations.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells construction services to the government, led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with $2.5B in FY2026 obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors also sells work in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction, which totaled $11.9M in FY2026 obligations.
